atom:entry.atom:title: Canada: RTR launch set for 9 November
atom:entry.atom:summary: [deadline] So what for merchants: Check provider readiness for the scheduled RTR launch, not assumed availability. Preview, pending Avi’s review. Payments Canada confirms a scheduled 9 November launch. This preview does not describe the service as already live. Who: Canadian banks, PSPs and payment users. Effective: 2026-11-09. Official source: https://www.payments.ca/canadas-real-time-rail-launch-confirmed-budget-2026

atom:entry.atom:title: Canada–EU: interlink work supported
atom:entry.atom:summary: [neutral] So what for merchants: Keep the proposed connection on your roadmap, not your live-route inventory. Preview, pending Avi’s review. A joint commitment supports work toward connecting instant payment systems. It is not an operating cross-border route. Who: Cross-border product and treasury teams. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.payments.ca/payments-canada-welcomes-joint-canada-eu-commitment-interlink-real-time-payment-systems
